resources.string: Bing daily image downloads today\'s Bing picture once a day (needs internet). Your own pictures appear in the list after you copy them to Android/data/com.gathin.tvhome/files/wallpapers/.
Light glass for the dock and the top buttons, with the wallpaper blurred behind it (Android 12 and newer; otherwise a translucent fill).

Shows city, weather and temperature next to the clock. The city comes from your internet address (ipwho.is, ip-api.com or ipinfo.io), the weather from Open-Meteo; checked at most every 30 minutes while Home is on screen. Needs internet.
